revision_budget: This R2 consumes the single P1345 contract revision authorized after R1. No further local contract revision remains.

revision_trigger.measurement: R1 required the checker to recompute SHA-256(domain_separator || challenge || process_nonce), but its eight-field closed primitive schema exposed only process_nonce_sha256. Recovering the 32-byte process_nonce preimage from SHA-256 is not a reproducible operation, so trusting challenge_response_sha256 would be probe self-attestation.
revision_trigger.repair_hypothesis: Expose the exact 32-byte nonce as canonical lowercase process_nonce_hex while retaining its digest. The checker can then decode bytes, recompute both hashes and enforce freshness/replay from public primitive observations.
revision_trigger.semantic_scope_delta: NONE. Only the primitive probe observation schema and the mechanically dependent hash/root clauses change.

normative_composition.binding_r2: p1345-contract-binding-r2.json at the exact hash recorded by p1345-contract-receipt-r2.json
normative_composition.rule: Decode the exact R1 spec and binding first. Replace only R1 artifact_schemas.probe_primitive_output_keys, unknown_probe_contract freshness/build/execution/derivation clauses, the corresponding spec unknown_probe freshness/no-self-attestation/fail-closed clauses, and authority-root contract identifiers/hashes with the exact R2 clauses below. Every other R1 clause, key, ordering rule, canonical-token obligation, inverse-normalization requirement, compiler/runtime gate, classification boundary, P1344/P1343/P1342 semantic obligation, Tekt ownership rule, forbidden binding, budget and scope remains normative byte-semantically without reinterpretation.
replaced_r1_clauses: The primitive probe output has nine exact fields by adding process_nonce_hex immediately before process_nonce_sha256.
The checker decodes process_nonce_hex and independently recomputes process_nonce_sha256 and challenge_response_sha256 from exact bytes.
Freshness/replay validation operates on the disclosed nonce bytes and their digest, with exact emitter and executable provenance.
P1345 authoring/execution roots identify R2 contract/binding and include the R1/blocker causal chain.

domain_separator.terminal_escape: The two displayed characters backslash-zero denote one terminal NUL byte 0x00 in the hashed byte sequence.

probe_repair.process_nonce_hex: Exactly 64 lowercase ASCII hexadecimal characters, no prefix or separators, decoding to exactly 32 bytes generated by the independently compiled sealed probe during the current invocation.
probe_repair.process_nonce_sha256: Exactly lowercase_hex(SHA-256(process_nonce_bytes)); the checker recomputes it from decoded process_nonce_hex and requires equality.
probe_repair.challenge: fresh_challenge_hex is exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters generated by the verifier, decoding to exactly 32 bytes and passed directly by the checker to the pinned probe.
probe_repair.challenge_response_sha256: Exactly lowercase_hex(SHA-256(domain_separator_bytes || challenge_bytes || process_nonce_bytes)); the checker recomputes it from the contract literal, its own challenge bytes and decoded process_nonce_hex.
probe_repair.invocation_nonce: invocation_nonce_hex is exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters generated by the verifier and invocation_nonce_sha256 must equal lowercase_hex(SHA-256(invocation_nonce_bytes)).
probe_repair.freshness_and_replay: Before accepting the primitive record, require process_nonce_bytes, process_nonce_sha256, challenge_bytes and invocation_nonce_bytes to be pairwise distinct where their domains overlap and absent from the current run's prior-value sets and every protected prior receipt. Reusing any process nonce, challenge, invocation nonce, primitive output bytes or challenge-response digest is Violated. The verifier persists the ordered seen-value digests for normal/repeat/reverse comparison.
probe_repair.emitter_and_binary: The checker starts the exact executable independently compiled from the pinned probe source with the frozen toolchain/build recipe, hashes executable bytes immediately before and after the single execution and requires both hashes equal the verifier-supplied pinned executable hash. It writes challenge/invocation bytes through the closed input channel and accepts output only from that child process. Candidate/sibling/stdin-file/preexisting receipt substitution, executable drift, additional stdout, nonempty stderr, nonzero exit or timeout is Violated.
probe_repair.primitive_not_answer: The nine primitive fields contain no expected result, classification, verdict, reason, witness, opaque or pass/fail claim. The checker derives its classification only after independently validating every primitive relation and every earlier source/compiler/runtime predicate.

classification.unknown: Unchanged in meaning from R1: only the checker-derived result for the single opaque dictionary-payload case after all earlier authority/source/compiler/runtime predicates and every R2 primitive hash/freshness/emitter check pass.
classification.violated: In addition to every R1 failure, invalid/missing/noncanonical process_nonce_hex, nonce digest mismatch, challenge-response mismatch, nonce/challenge/invocation replay, wrong emitter or executable drift is Violated. Missing candidate runtime remains Violated, never Unknown.
classification.preserved: Unchanged from R1 for inspectable inputs that pass every applicable predicate.
classification.no_input_answer: Cases, candidates and probe outputs still cannot provide classification or witness. Adding process_nonce_hex adds a verifiable primitive observation, not an answer channel.

authority_update.authoring: R2 oracle artifacts must pin and compose this exact R2 spec/binding/receipt plus the R1/blocker causal chain. No R1-only oracle may be sealed.
authority_update.execution: Per-invocation root continues to include exact executable hash, fresh challenge, invocation nonce, primitive output hash and required runtime receipt. The checker rehashes the executable both before and after execution and derives nonce-dependent evidence itself.
authority_update.fail_closed: Any R1-only root, omitted raw nonce, alternate response formula, missing causal pin, hash/schema drift or candidate-supplied probe receipt is AUTHORITY_ROOT/PROBE_AUTHORITY/PROBE_CHALLENGE and Violated.
